verdict.rationale: A federal corporate registry could plausibly publish a public API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only a web-based Online Filing Centre and PDF/email channels, and the probe explicitly notes that the registry documents no transactional API. The keyless CKAN API answers on open.canada.ca, which is the host national open-data platform, not Corporations Canada's own documented API, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: the national open-data layer answers keyless agents with structured JSON; the registry itself documents no transactional API on any surface checked.
